evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved straight from logistics probing into pricing without surfacing customer's concerns first.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the rep asking the two-concerns question.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep mentioned day-before and day-after availability and customer selected the day before, but no dollar savings amount was given and no flexibility beyond that was explored. Just 'Great sounds good.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never asked for the business. Call ended with 'feel free to reach out if you'd like to get on schedule' after customer declined due to 2.5-hour minimum.

top_strength: Jules clearly articulated the all-inclusive pricing model and fee transparency early, explaining exactly what is and isn't included ($190/hour, no fuel/disassembly/hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum with 15-minute prorating).
coaching_note: Ask the two-concerns question before diving into pricing — the customer's concern about a 1.5-hour move hitting a 2.5-hour minimum should have surfaced early enough to address it with prep framing and value-days anchoring instead of becoming an objection that ends the call.
